scientific_integrity: The theorem and count formulas are supported by a self-contained argument and reproducible independent-from-formula finite enumeration. Closest known equivalence to locating domination on crown graphs is disclosed. Self-review are not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Full text of the early 2022 Canoy--Salasalan locating-hop-domination paper was inaccessible; only bibliographic abstract could be inspected. No exact public day for that older paper was verified. Unindexed or differently worded prior work may cover this classification. Exhaustive finite tests are supplementary to the general proof.
title: Locating-hop domination of complete prisms: exact enumerators and a five-column minimality transition
